##: Windows builds are flat portable ZIPs with FlClash.exe at the root; the x64 and ARM64 assets are separate files and there is no 32-bit Windows build.
Release tags carry a v prefix (v0.9.3) but the asset names do not, so autoupdate.url uses v$version for the tag path and $version for the filename.

The pinned hashes match both the locally computed SHA-256 of the downloaded ZIPs and the vendor's SHA256SUMS asset. autoupdate.hash is omitted so Excavator reads the sha256 digest published on each GitHub release asset.
Settings, profiles and the database are written to the application support directory (%APPDATA%\com.follow\clash on Windows), not into the app directory, so no persist entry is needed.
description: A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta
notes: Profiles, settings and the database live in "$env:APPDATA\com.follow\clash" and survive Scoop upgrades.
